title: Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.20853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motor imagery (MI) enables a brain-computer interface (BCI) to decode movement intentions without overt movement. Hybrid electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) classification combines complementary signals, but inter-subject variability and the design of information exchange between modalities affect generalization to new subjects. We propose a framework that combines Cross-Subject Class Mixup (CSCM) with Selective Attention. CSCM aims to construct new training data to make the model robust against inter-subject variability. It independently selects EEG and fNIRS donor trials from other training subjects within the anchor class and mixes each modality while preserving the original label. Selective Attention provides an effective way to simultaneously model the temporal signal characteristics and fuse the two modalities. translated_title: 基于混合跨被试类别Mixup与选择性注意的运动想象分类
translated_abstract: 运动想象（MI）使脑机接口（BCI）能够在没有明显实际动作的情况下解码运动意图。混合脑电（EEG）与功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）的分类方法结合了两种互补的信号，但被试间差异以及模态间信息交换机制的设计会影响模型对新被试的泛化能力。我们提出了一个将跨被试类别Mixup（CSCM）与选择性注意（Selective Attention）相结合的框架。CSCM旨在构建新的训练数据，使模型对被试间差异具有鲁棒性：它从锚定类别内的其他训练被试中独立选择EEG和fNIRS供体试次，并在保持原始标签的同时对每种模态分别进行混合。选择性注意提供了一种有效的方式，可以同时建模时间信号特征并融合两种模态。它为EEG保留了因果时间自注意力机制，并使用分类token……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个结合跨被试类别Mixup（CSCM）数据增强与选择性注意机制的混合EEG-fNIRS框架，通过跨被试混合构建新训练数据以增强对被试间差异的鲁棒性，并通过选择性注意同时建模时间特征与融合双模态信息，从而提升运动想象分类对新被试的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a hybrid EEG-fNIRS motor imagery classification framework that combines Cross-Subject Class Mixup (CSCM) data augmentation with Selective Attention, enhancing robustness to inter-subject variability and improving generalization to unseen subjects.
